features.name: age_z_clipped
features.description: Age centered near 38.07 years and scaled by about 9 years, clipped to reduce outlier leverage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM a bounded lifecycle severity coordinate with near-unit scale.

features.name: credit_score_z_clipped
features.description: Credit score centered near 656.52 and scaled by about 81.13 points, clipped for robust margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows credit quality to enter as a smooth monotone margin component.

features.name: log_balance_scaled
features.description: Log-scaled account balance normalized by the observed upper training-fold bound.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skew while preserving rank information for balance-heavy accounts.

features.name: balance_salary_log_ratio
features.description: Log transform of account balance divided by salary with a small denominator offset.
features.expected_model_benefit: Expresses leverage-like intensity on a smoother scale than the raw ratio.

features.name: tenure_age_share_clipped
features.description: Tenure divided by age and clipped to a compact relationship-maturity range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relationship maturity relative to lifecycle in a bounded ratio.

features.name: product_complexity_excess
features.description: Hinge score for product count above two products, with no excess for one or two products.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets a linear margin model capture elevated account complexity only after a practical threshold.

features.name: inactive_product_load
features.description: Product load among inactive accounts; active accounts map to zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an interpretable interaction between activity and product complexity not available from separate columns alone.

features.name: engagement_card_product_score
features.description: Weighted engagement composite from active membership, credit-card ownership, and product depth.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth low-dimensional engagement projection aligned with linear/SVM margins.

features.name: regional_balance_contrast
features.description: Signed log-balance regional exposure contrasting Germany and France; Spain maps to zero through the regional coefficient.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a region-by-balance interaction so the model can use different balance slopes by market.

features.name: female_age_contrast
features.description: Signed age exposure using female versus male one-hot contrast, with magnitude growing from young adult to senior ages.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear separator to represent gender-specific age slopes through one continuous interaction.

features.name: relationship_stability_judgment
features.description: Assessor assigns a 0.0 to 1.0 score from tenure, active membership, card ownership, product depth, and balance-to-salary context; high values indicate an embedded, stable banking relationship.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses non-linear engagement cues into a smooth ordinal input that a linear SVM can weight directly.

features.name: financial_pressure_judgment
features.description: Assessor assigns a 0.0 to 1.0 score from credit score, balance, salary, product count, and age; high values indicate financial strain or account complexity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a semantic severity coordinate when multiple financial cues jointly suggest pressure.
